summary: Added seam regressions for Vault ATH withdrawal TON refunding and owner-facing ATH notify deposit value boundaries.
covered_flows: WithdrawAth with the canonical 0.03 TON value clears pending, transfers ATH, and credits returned callback value back to the user's internal TON balance.
Old notify-transfer minimum without the owner first-hop reserve does not debit the source ATH wallet or credit Vault.
Canonical owner notify value reaches the official Vault ATH wallet and Vault without trapping large TON excess in the official ATH wallet.
existing_contract_evidence: M32 Vault value-flow fix: PendingAthWithdrawal stores refundable TON cap and refunds callback value minus local reserve.
ATHWallet owner-facing notify transfers use bounded downstream value and refund owner overpayment.
ATHWallet boundary tests cover owner notify first-hop minimum.

verification.focused_tests: npm.cmd run test:file -- tests\vault-ath-integration.test.ts tests\vault-ath-invariants.test.ts tests\ath-wallet-transfer.test.ts tests\ath-wallet-boundary-negative.test.ts

production_note: No contract bytecode changed in this milestone. The implemented-subset manifest remains non-final until mainnet route, funding, address, and final-genesis evidence blockers are closed.
